svg.title: Certifications
svg.desc: Certifications: Associate Cloud Engineer, Google Cloud, issued Aug 30, 2025, valid until Aug 30, 2028; AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Amazon Web Services, issued Apr 8, 2026, valid until Apr 8, 2029; Certified Partner Specialist: Gemini Enterprise Agent Development, Google Cloud, issued Sep 20, 2026, valid until Mar 20, 2027.
